get.description: Retrieve all directed prerequisite edges in the curriculum graph.

schema.title: Response List Prerequisites Api V1 Prerequisites Get

post.description:
Add a directed prerequisite edge with automated cycle prevention.

Validates:
  1. Both skills exist in the database.
  2. No self-loops (skill_id != requires_skill_id).
  3. Edge does not already exist.
  4. Adding this edge will NOT introduce a cycle into the prerequisite graph.

delete.description: Remove a prerequisite edge from the graph.

post.summary: Analyse skill gaps between learner and target career
post.description:
Compute which required career skills the learner has not yet confirmed.

The C# backend sends:
- The learner's current confirmed skill set (binary: have or don't have).
- The target career ID.
- Optional probabilistic mastery values.

Returns a structured, multi-factor gap report ordered by priority.

post.summary: Generate a personalized, multi-objective learning path for a learner
post.description:
Generates an ordered, prerequisite-aware, multi-objective curriculum path.

The C# backend calls this to get the optimal pedagogical sequence,
supporting learner pacing preferences, mastery states, and Pareto alternatives.

post.summary: Record assessment evidence and update BKT mastery
post.description: Record an interaction or assessment score, applying Bayesian Knowledge Tracing.
Record multiple observations in sequential order.
